About.Name: Samuel M Vick
About.AboutText: I am an Electrical Engineering student at Seattle Pacific University. I am expecting to graduate in June 2027.

Experience.ExperienceText: I earned an Associate of Science from North Seattle College. While there, I worked at the tutoring center and got experience explaining problem solving skills for math and physics. Now I am pursuing an electrical engineering degree at SPU.

Project1.Title: 25 kHz Filter
Project1.Desc: This circuit takes in a signal, and if a 3V 25kHz component is present, it will turn on an LED.

Project2.Title: Dual-Adjustable-Power-Supply-with-Multiple-Output-Levels
Project2.Desc: This board takes a 120V AC input and uses several linear regulators (and one op amp) to create seven output voltage levels

Project3.Title: Flyback Converter 120VAC to 3.3VDC and Variable Output Buck-Boost Converter
Project3.Desc: This board has two separate converter. One is a flyback converter that converts 120VAC to 3.3V DC. The other converts 12VAC to a variable 1.2V to 5.2V output

Project4.Title: Buck Converter 24V to 5V 5A
Project4.Desc: Designed circuit in Altium, soldered through-hole components on PCB, and tested circuit output up to 5A successfully.
